benefits.title: $300 Digital Entertainment Credit
benefits.terms: Demo terms: up to $25 back each calendar month on eligible streaming and news subscriptions paid with the card after enrolling.

benefits.title: Walmart+ Monthly Membership Credit
benefits.terms: Demo terms: a monthly Walmart+ membership fee paid with the card is credited back, up to $12.95 plus tax.

benefits.title: $200 Uber Cash
benefits.terms: Demo terms: $15 of Uber Cash is added to a linked Uber account each month, with $35 in December. Unused Uber Cash expires at month end.

benefits.title: $400 Resy Credit
benefits.terms: Demo terms: after enrolling, up to $100 back each calendar quarter at participating Resy restaurants in the U.S.

benefits.title: $300 lululemon Credit
benefits.terms: Demo terms: after enrolling, up to $75 back each calendar quarter on eligible lululemon purchases in U.S. stores or online.

benefits.title: $600 Hotel Credit
benefits.terms: Demo terms: up to $300 back twice a year on prepaid bookings through the issuer's hotel programs, with a minimum stay.

benefits.title: $120 Uber One Credit
benefits.terms: Demo terms: an Uber One membership billed to the card is credited back, up to $120 per calendar year.

benefits.title: $200 Airline Fee Credit
benefits.terms: Demo terms: after choosing one qualifying airline, up to $200 per calendar year back on incidental fees such as bags or seat selection.

benefits.title: $200 Oura Ring Credit
benefits.terms: Demo terms: after enrolling, up to $200 per calendar year back on an Oura Ring bought directly from Oura.

benefits.title: $219 CLEAR+ Credit
benefits.terms: Demo terms: a CLEAR+ membership charged to the card is credited back, up to $219 per calendar year.

benefits.title: $300 Equinox Credit
benefits.terms: Demo terms: after enrolling, up to $300 per calendar year back on eligible Equinox club or app memberships.
